tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Both Meria creams and the Duo with prices, sizes and links, the live buying facts (offers, shipping, returns, subscription), and when Meria is or is not the right recommendation.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: The full label of one product: every ingredient in label order with its plain name and the reason it is there, published active levels with their trials, directions, the caution line as printed, and the product FAQ.

tools.name: check_ingredients
tools.description: For each ingredient or family named (for example "coconut", "fragrance", "dimethicone", "shea", "niacinamide"), whether it is on the label of each Meria cream, and whether it is one Meria never uses.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Creates a Meria checkout for the creams the buyer chose and returns the link for them to pay. One of each is priced as the Duo automatically. Up to 10 of each. For a subscription, send the buyer to https://meria.us/subscription instead.
